idea-plugin.name: 3D Visualizer
idea-plugin.description:
Inspect local point clouds, meshes and scan data directly in editor tabs.

3D Visualizer provides interactive camera controls, multiple objects, visibility controls, measurements, point appearance settings and export tools using the same visualization engine as the VS Code extension.

This first preview targets the 2024.3 IntelliJ Platform and requires the JetBrains Runtime with JCEF. Tested on PyCharm Community 2024.3.5 on macOS ARM64.

Use self-contained assets: external glTF/OBJ companion files are not resolved. Closing an editor resets its scene and camera state. This plugin does not include the separate scientific image viewer.

Documentation and limitations · Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0 — First standalone 3D preview for JetBrains IDEs: local point clouds, meshes and scan data, shared viewer controls, native download handling and isolated per-editor file delivery.
